data.gender_notes: Nadalia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Nadav meaning ‘little one’, Nadalia is a beautiful Biblical name with deep spiritual significance for Christian parents. The name Nadalia carries the meaning “Little girl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nadalia usually hope their child will grow to embody little girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: נדליה
in_hebrew.meaning: המתנה של אלוהים לנadalia היא שמחה גדולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נדליה הוא שילוב של המילים 'נד' ו'אליה', שפירושן מתנה של אלוהים. הוא מבטא את הרעיון של מתנה אלוהית יקרה ומיוחדת. השם נדליה מופיע בתנ"ך ומתאר את שמחת האל על מתנתו לאנושות.

in_greek.name: Ναδαλίας
in_greek.meaning: Το δώρο του Θεού είναι χαρά μεγάλη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ναδαλίας προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις που σχετίζονται με το δώρο του Θεού. Στην πλούσια παράδοση της Ορθοδοξίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη χαρά και την ευλογία που προέρχεται από τον Θεό. Είναι ένα όνομα που φέρει την αγάπη και τη φροντίδα του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Nadalia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nadalia significat donum Dei, gaudium et felicitatem. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen exprimit gratiam et benedictionem divinam. Est nomen quod portare gaudium et spem in vitam cotidianam.

in_english.name: Nadalia
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, great joy and happiness

data.spiritual_symbolism: A name meaning "hope" in Hebrew, symbolizing the unwavering belief in a brighter future and God's grace and mercy.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nadalia was a 5th century Christian saint from Rome. The name Nadalia carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
